title: Integrate final rehearsal source
goal: After T005 and T006 are terminal and independently reviewed, materialize the exact immutable T006 activation-source artifact as the integrated T001/T002 source base, apply the exact immutable T005 rehearsal-patch artifact inside the Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree, validate the resulting final source tree, and create the leased content-addressed whole-source rehearsal artifact that T003 must consume. T007 publishes no remote Git ref and does not use a live T005/T006 workspace or moving Git ref as successor authority.

approval.note: This task may read and mutate the exclusively reserved Heim-PC Git object/ref store only through its Bureau-recorded run-scoped worktree and local run-scoped non-main workspace branch. It may read the exact immutable activation-source and rehearsal-patch artifacts and create the bound rehearsal-source artifact. Workspace path, local branch and frozen baseline are generated and recorded by Bureau for the exact run. No git push or remote ref mutation is authorized or required. It does not merge to main and grants no runtime, storage, EFI, firmware, reboot or production-cutover authority.

acceptance.assertion: T007 begins only after T005 and T006 are terminal and independently reviewed. Evidence binds the exact content-addressed artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source manifest from T006 and artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-patch manifest from T005, including their source commit/tree, content digests and review evidence. Missing, mutable, mismatched or ambiguous artifact identity fails closed before integration mutation.

Before creating the local final-integration revision, the task holds the exclusive component.heim-pc.nixos-source-integration claim materialized as path:/home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git; lease loss or object/ref-store drift fails closed before another Git mutation.

Before the first Git/index/tree mutation, the execution envelope contains a non-null Bureau workspace whose workspace_path, workspace_branch, baseline_commit and source_head_at_intent are bound to this exact run. All final integration mutation and validation occurs only there; a missing workspace, reused fixed integration worktree, branch mismatch, dirty preimage or run/workspace identity drift fails closed.

Before applying the rehearsal patch, T007 independently re-hashes and validates both immutable input manifests, materializes the exact T006 activation-source artifact into the run-scoped workspace, and verifies its tree/content identity. It then applies only the exact T005 rehearsal-patch artifact whose baseline and touched-path manifest match the canonical architecture contract. A live T005/T006 workspace, local branch tip, moving ref or remote branch is never an authority input.

Inside the exact run-scoped workspace, a receipt-bound integration plan combines exactly the materialized T006 whole-source artifact and the reviewed T005 component patch artifact. Any conflict is explicitly reviewed, and tree/diff comparison proves the final revision contains the intended T001/T002 source plus T005 rehearsal changes and no unrelated source change.

Focused T001/T002/T005 tests plus required Heim-PC repository validation are green in the exact run-scoped final-integration worktree on the exact final integration tree, and independent review finds no material integration regression before the rehearsal-source artifact is created.

While holding the exclusive artifact.heim-pc.nixos-rehearsal-source write claim, T007 creates a content-addressed whole-source artifact and immutable manifest from the exact reviewed final integration tree. The manifest binds the final local commit/tree, both input artifact digests, archive/content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity; immediate independent re-hash/readback proves artifact contents match the reviewed source tree. Once fixed, this artifact—not any Git ref—is the durable successor authority.

T007 performs no git push and creates or updates no remote Git ref. Its Bureau-generated workspace branch is local/run-scoped only; T003 receives the exact reviewed source exclusively through the content-addressed rehearsal-source artifact and its immutable manifest.

The T007 terminal evidence designates the content-addressed rehearsal-source artifact as T003's only declarative/reconstruction source and binds the final commit/tree plus both input artifact identities. T003 fails closed if the artifact digest, manifest, source commit/tree or Control Release Set/lock binding differs; it never relies on a moving or remote T007 Git ref.

T007 performs no remote branch publication, main-branch merge, production NixOS activation, partitioning, formatting, LUKS/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, reboot or equivalent production-cutover effect.

metadata.workspace_contract: Bureau run-scoped worktree and local non-main branch recorded in the execution envelope
